notes.1-4: On a hillside ground, 'the players struggled with the pitch at the far end' can be read as the slope or the playing field itself.
notes.2-3: 'Everyone noticed the salesman's pitch rising as he got excited' can be read as the highness of his voice or as his sales talk.

notes.0-3: 'Congress debated the draft' can mean a rough version of the bill or the call-up of soldiers.
notes.1-4: 'She took a long, cool draft at the open window' can mean a current of air she breathed in or a swallow of drink.
